_note: Component specs updated for the approved light-theme visual direction: navy (not green) is the default primary/brand/navigation color; green is a success-only accent; no pure-white major surfaces (white is retained only for input interiors). These are the approved implementation values. See design-specs/functionality/light-theme-visual-direction.md and tokens/colors.json (semantic roles).

primary._note: Primary = deep navy. Do NOT use green for default primary actions. Green is reserved for save/confirm/success (see 'confirm' below).

confirm._note: Success/save/confirm actions only (e.g. 'Save Workspace', 'Accept', completion). Not a general primary button.

input._note: White input interior is an approved exception (high-readability content region).

card._note: Cards are elevated content surfaces on the blue-gray app canvas (#D6E0EA). Separate from the canvas by tone + shadow, not a border alone. Never a white card on white.

sidebar._note: Deep-navy persistent chrome. Active nav item uses a navy/brand highlight, NEVER green.

modal._note: Modal body is a content surface; reserve pure white for input interiors and small dense regions inside it.
